name: Uchi no Kanojo
source:
The first title by Argonauts, a sister company of MOONSTONE.

Tachibanaki Keisuke, a young man who finally navigating the waters of adult life. His company might not be a big name, but it was the job he'd always wanted, and life was treating him well.

However, despite his enthusiasm and dreams, living on his own for the first time was starting to wear him down. It was during one of these tired moments that a thought popped into his head...

[I]"Having a girlfriend wouldn't be so bad..."[/i]

One day, Keisuke's childhood friend, Matoi Ayame, shows up unexpectedly with her luggage. It turns out her parents are moving overseas for work, leaving Ayame behind to focus on her upcoming college entrance exams. Her worried parents, who are close friends with Keisuke's family, ask if she can stay with Keisuke until they get settled.

With that, the unexpected cohabitation begins. As they spend more and more time together, their long camaraderie starts to evolve into something deeper, something…

[b]Beyond just childhood friends...[/b]

[Based on [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1248/]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
MOONSTONE的姊妹公司Argonauts的第一款游戏。

橘木圭介，一个终于在成人生活中航行的年轻人。他的公司可能名气不大，但却是他一直想要的工作，而且生活对他也很好。

然而，尽管他充满热情和梦想，但第一次独自生活开始让他疲惫不堪。就在这个疲惫的时刻，他的脑海中突然浮现出一个想法……

[I]“有女朋友也不错啊……”[/i]

有一天，圭介的青梅竹马，间井彩女带着行李突然出现。原来，她的父母要移居海外工作，留下绫雨专注于即将到来的高考。她担心的父母是圭介家人的亲密朋友，他们询问她是否可以和圭介住在一起，直到他们安顿下来。

就这样，意想不到的同居开始了。随着他们在一起的时间越来越多，他们长久以来的友情开始演变成更深层次的东西……

[b]不仅仅是儿时的朋友……[/b]
